channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Top 10 African countries absorbing the most Chinese exports, based on recent data
item.description: Latest trade data shows that China shipped over $100 billion worth of goods to Africa in the first half of 2025, with Nigeria, South Africa, and Egypt among the continent’s top 10 countries absorbing the most Chinese exports.

item.title: Ghana takes control of its gold as local refining operation begins [PHOTOS]
item.description: Ghana has taken a significant step towards retaining more value from its gold resources by commencing local gold refining for artisanal and small-scale mining.

item.title: Ghana and Zambia sign visa waiver as African nations deepen open-borders cooperation
item.description: Ghana and Zambia have signed a landmark visa waiver agreement that will allow citizens of both countries to travel between the two nations without the need for visas, a move officials say will deepen people-to-people ties and unlock new economic opportunities.

item.title: Ghana says its refineries are ‘insignificant’ compared to Nigeria’s Dangote facility, but the country is ready to import
item.description: Ghana has pledged to import petroleum products from Nigeria’s Dangote Petroleum Refinery in Lagos, citing the limited capacity of its own refineries.

item.title: Zimbabwe courts partners to unlock 44 million ounces of platinum in a $500 million mine
item.description: The state-owned mining outfit, Mutapa Platinum Group, in Zimbabwe, is actively seeking mining partners to facilitate the development of its $500 million platinum mine.

item.title: Barred in South Africa for ‘not being black’, Starlink enters predominantly black Senegal
item.description: Starlink, which was prohibited from operating in South Africa last month due to a dispute between its CEO, Elon Musk, and the South African government, has identified a new market in Africa: Senegal.

item.title: Top 10 most socially progressive African countries in 2026
item.description: Africa’s social progress in 2026 shows steady gains in basic services, such as education, and healthcare, but deep gaps remain. Ranked 56th out of 171 countries with a Social Progress Index score of 72.28, Mauritius leads Africa in social performance in 2026.

item.title: Cameroon joins the list of African countries looking to Dangote for refining assistance
item.description: Sonara, a state-owned oil refinery in Cameroon, recently initiated a dialogue with Nigeria's Dangote Group in an effort to find funding and supply options for the long-delayed restart of its operations, which have been halted since a massive fire in 2019.

item.title: China offers South Africa duty-free market access amid pressure from US tariffs
item.description: China will allow duty-free imports of selected products from South Africa under a trade agreement currently being finalised, signalling Pretoria’s accelerating pivot toward alternative global markets as relations with the United States remain strained.

item.title: US threatens Africa’s second-most powerful military with sanctions over Russian Su-57 fighter jets deal
item.description: The United States has warned it may impose sanctions on Algeria over its decision to purchase advanced Russian-made Su-57 fighter jets, raising fresh questions about Africa’s defence ties with Moscow amid heightened global geopolitical tensions.
